acceptance_rule: Gate2 hash-bound PDF publication clock and runtime entry_date/target_price pass; every window has at least 20 eligible issuer-release legs, at least 10 tickers, top1 share at most 30%, and survival at least 5%; same-run core plus sleeve aggregate EV and PnL deltas beat the accepted candidate-pool comparator +0.5286 and +10432.91 USD; old_thin EV/PnL deltas are nonnegative; drawdown worsening is at most 0.5pp; top5 positive contribution at most 60% and one ticker at most 50%; otherwise remove daily wiring and reject.

one issuer-release leg with distinct-application dedupe

prediction.confidence_reason: NEWA additions are economically more material than the rejected routine 510(k) clearance face, and the hash-bound monthly archive passes all three density and concentration windows (27/28/25 executable issuer releases across 12/15/12 tickers). The main risk is that FDA publication occurs after approval information is already priced and generic additions have little issuer-level materiality.

calibration.surprise_note: The fixed basket added modest aggregate PnL and improved drawdown, but the gain was too concentrated and almost entirely mid-window; old-thin EV and late PnL did not hold.
